summary: The registrant, Xos, Inc., filed a Form 8-K under Items 1.01 and 9.01 to report entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with institutional investors and a Placement Agency Agreement with Roth Capital Partners, LLC. The transaction is a registered direct offering of 1,090,910 shares at $5.50 per share, raising $6.0 million gross proceeds. Offering completed June 5, 2026; Roth received 6.5% fee. The shelf registration statement (Form S-3, File 333-272284) becomes effective June 8, 2023. This is routine capital raising, not a special situation.
